<style id="kabat-article-standard">
/* NASEKADAN_ARTICLE_STANDARD_V2
   Autoritativni zaklad vizualni sablony pro vsechny clanky s data-article-template="unified-v1".
   Specialni komponenty clanku mohou mit vlastni CSS, ale zakladni shell, karta, typografie
   a pravy panel zustavaji jednotne napric webem. */

.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"]{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,840px) 300px;
  gap:36px;
  align-items:start;
  padding:54px 0 72px;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article{
  background:#fff;
  border:1px solid #e1e6e8;
  border-radius:26px;
  padding:38px 42px 48px;
  box-shadow:0 18px 44px #14232d18;
  min-width:0;
  box-sizing:border-box;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article h1{
  font:900 clamp(40px,6vw,64px)/1.02 Georgia,serif;
  letter-spacing:-.04em;
  margin:.22em 0 .3em;
  color:#17242d;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article h2{
  font:900 33px/1.16 Georgia,serif;
  margin:46px 0 15px;
  color:#17242d;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article h3{
  font:900 24px/1.2 Georgia,serif;
  margin:34px 0 12px;
  color:#17242d;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article p,
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article li{
  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.7;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article .leadtext{
  font-size:23px;
  color:#465862;
  line-height:1.52;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article .tag{
  font-weight:900;
  color:#9f2626;
  letter-spacing:.065em;
  font-size:13px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article a{
  color:#9f2626;
  text-underline-offset:3px;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article .article-figure{
  margin:28px 0 32px;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article .article-figure img,
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article img.hero-image{
  display:block;
  width:100%;
  height:auto;
  border-radius:20px;
  box-shadow:0 14px 34px #16242d22;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > aside.sticky{
  position:sticky;
  top:100px;
  min-width:0;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > aside.sticky .sidebox{
  background:#fff;
  border:1px solid #dce3e6;
  border-radius:18px;
  padding:20px;
  margin-bottom:18px;
  box-shadow:0 10px 30px #16242d0d;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > aside.sticky .sidebox h3{
  font:900 23px Georgia,serif;
  margin:0 0 12px;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > aside.sticky .sidebox p,
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > aside.sticky .sidebox li{
  font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.5;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .promo-card,
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .article-rail-card,
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .featured-rotating-ad,
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .featured-cleaning-ad{
  max-width:100%;
  box-sizing:border-box;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .promo-card img,
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .article-rail-card img,
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .featured-rotating-ad img,
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .featured-cleaning-ad img{
  max-width:100%;
  height:auto;
}

/* AD_FALLBACK_FIX_20260912
   Pokud reklamni kreativni obrazek chybi nebo selze, nevyrabime zadnou falesnou
   barevnou plochu. Reklama zustane jako kompaktni, citelna textova karta. */
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .featured-cleaning-ad .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img)),
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .featured-rotating-ad .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img)),
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img)){
  display:block!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
  padding:0!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  aspect-ratio:auto!important;
  border-radius:18px!important;
  background:#fff!important;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .featured-cleaning-ad .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img))::before,
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .featured-rotating-ad .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img))::before,
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img))::before{
  content:none!important;
  display:none!important;
}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img)) > .promo-banner-fallback{
  display:none!important;
}
html body .article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img)) > .promo-wide-copy{
  display:flex!important;
  flex-direction:column!important;
  gap:7px!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  padding:20px 24px!important;
  color:#17242d!important;
  background:#fff!important;
}
html body .article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img)) > .promo-wide-copy strong{
  display:block!important;
  color:#17242d!important;
  font-size:24px!important;
  line-height:1.15!important;
}
html body .article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img)) > .promo-wide-copy .promo-description{
  display:block!important;
  color:#52616a!important;
  line-height:1.45!important;
}
html body .article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img)) > .promo-wide-copy b{
  display:block!important;
  color:#9f2626!important;
  margin-top:3px!important;
}

@media(max-width:980px){
  .article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"]{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
  }
  .article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > aside.sticky{
    position:static;
  }
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"]{
    padding:28px 0 48px;
  }
  .article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article{
    padding:27px 21px 34px;
    border-radius:20px;
  }
  .article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article h1{
    font-size:42px;
  }
  .article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article .leadtext{
    font-size:20px;
  }
  html body .article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img)) > .promo-wide-copy{
    padding:16px 18px 19px!important;
  }
  html body .article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] .promo-card-wide.promo-card-full-image:not(:has(.promo-banner img)) > .promo-wide-copy strong{
    font-size:21px!important;
  }
}


/* KABAT_LAYOUT_REPAIR_20260923: keep the article readable on desktop and mobile. */
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"]{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 300px}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article h1{font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,48px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.025em;overflow-wrap:break-word}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article .meta{font-size:14px;color:#65727a}
.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > aside.sticky{padding:0;background:transparent;border:0;box-shadow:none}
@media(max-width:980px){.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"]{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:700px){.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article h1{font-size:32px}.article-shell[data-article-template="unified-v1"] > .article{padding:24px 20px 32px}}
</style>
